Hi Aditya —

Quick heads up from the transload yard: Pacific Transload flagged a mismatch on the importer-of-record (IOR) name between the BOL we received and their inbound manifest. Because of the IOR discrepancy they are requesting a copy of the broker's continuous bond or a signed power of attorney before they can accept tender and release to local delivery.

We can hold the crate at yard but that pushes us past their normal warehouse cutoff for same-day loading (cutoff today 15:00). If you can provide one of the following ASAP we can avoid an extra day of detention and an off-hour re-handling fee:
- copy of continuous bond (CBP Form 301) OR
- signed limited POA naming Coastline as agent for release

If neither is possible, we can arrange a same-day offload and expedite release for an additional $220. Let me know how you want to proceed.

Nick Turner
Operations Manager, Coastline Logistics
